name: UR-01
title: Stereoscopic 3D Vision
description: The surgeon needs a high-definition 3D view of the surgical site to perceive depth accurately.

name: UR-02
title: Haptic Tissue Feedback
description: The surgeon must feel physical resistance matching the tissue density being manipulated.

name: UR-03
title: Sub-20ms Latency
description: The system must respond to surgeon inputs instantly to prevent over-correction during delicate cuts.

name: UR-04
title: Ergonomic Console
description: The console must support a seated posture for operations lasting up to 8 hours without fatigue.

name: UR-05
title: Maintain Sterile Field
description: All patient-side components must be sterilizable or compatible with sterile draping.

name: UR-06
title: Hard Emergency Stop
description: The surgeon needs a physical button to instantly freeze all robotic movement.

name: UR-07
title: Two-Way Audio
description: The surgeon must be able to communicate clearly with the patient-side OR staff.

name: UR-08
title: Vital Signs Overlay
description: Patient vitals (HR, BP, SpO2) must be visible within the surgeon's field of view.

name: UR-09
title: Dual-Console Mentoring
description: Two surgeons must be able to share control of the robot for training purposes.

name: UR-10
title: Surgical Video Recording
description: The system must record the entire procedure from the endoscope's perspective.

name: UR-11
title: Intuitive Clutching
description: The surgeon must be able to reposition their hands without moving the robotic instruments.

name: UR-12
title: Uninterruptible Power
description: The robot must continue operating safely if hospital grid power fails.

name: UR-13
title: Rapid Instrument Swap
description: OR staff must be able to detach and attach new surgical instruments in under 10 seconds.

name: UR-14
title: Collision Avoidance
description: The robotic arms must never collide with each other or the patient's exterior.

name: UR-15
title: System Alarms
description: The system must provide audible and visual alerts for any hardware or software faults.

name: UR-16
title: Quick OR Setup
description: The robot must be ready for surgery within 15 minutes of entering the OR.

name: UR-17
title: Cart Portability
description: The patient-side cart must be easily moved between operating rooms by a single person.

name: UR-18
title: Pre-Op Diagnostics
description: The system must automatically test all joints and sensors before allowing surgery to begin.

name: UR-19
title: Simulation Training Mode
description: The console must support virtual reality simulation software for surgeon practice.

name: UR-20
title: HIPAA Data Privacy
description: All recorded patient data and video must be encrypted at rest and in transit.

name: UR-21
title: Foot Pedal Controls
description: The surgeon must use foot pedals to control electrocautery and camera zoom.
